summary: Altimmune, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of 64.25 million shares of common stock, pre-funded warrants for up to 10.75 million shares, and common stock warrants to purchase up to 75 million shares at $3.00 per share. The offering price was $3.00 per share (or $2.999 per pre-funded warrant unit), with total proceeds to the company of approximately $211.5 million after underwriting discounts. The common stock warrants expire on the earlier of five years or 45 days after a Phase 3 MASH trial data readout. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; thus it falls under 'None'.
